flags.title: 62 of the 78 CS2 fixtures the lobby lists still carry June/July kickoff timestamps
flags.detail: HotSpawn ships these fixtures with a published start time months before the current pick'em week (status 'scheduled', stage 'waiting for information'). The lobby counts them in the week (its own tier filter reads All tiers (78) B (26) C (52) and every tournament count matches), but their lock time is long past, so they cannot be picked. They are published here with a research line where one exists and listed as unresolved where it does not — never dropped, never guessed.

flags.title: HLTV refuses automated reads (HTTP 403), so it cannot be a live probability input
flags.detail: The collector probes https://www.hltv.org/matches on every run and records the result. HLTV pages are used here only for identity cross-checks that were read and linked by hand (see the alias evidence links); no scraper output feeds a line. Official Valve standings and licensed books/exchange carry every number.

flags.title: Valve's newest published standings file is 16 days old (2026_10_05)
flags.detail: Valve has not published a newer snapshot, so every VRS-model and bound row uses ratings that predate recent results. The date is shown with every rating.

flags.title: 9 fixture(s) contain an organisation with more than one Valve rating row
flags.detail: Valve keeps separate rows for older rosters of the same organisation. Guessing would invent a probability, so those teams are treated as unrated unless the official details file identifies one active roster unambiguously.

flags.title: HotSpawn crowd percentages are deliberately not used
flags.detail: The lobby shows how other players picked. It is not a price, has no stake behind it and would make this desk a mirror of the crowd, so the parser drops the field before any row is built. A test asserts the board never contains it.

verification.check: every published line sums to 1 and its pick is the higher probability
every market line reproduces its stored consensus
every VRS-model line recomputes from its published delta and k
every originated line links the official rating file it came from
every row links an official HotSpawn page
every unresolved row is flagged as unresolved
the inventory covers every fixture the lobby lists
no HotSpawn crowd percentage is stored anywhere in the board

detail.note: the snapshot parser drops the lobby's 'picked %' fields before they reach a row
